purpose: Originate a spread and a total for every unplayed Week 10 game from certified league inputs only, so that the arithmetic is public and reviewable. This is a baseline for grading, not a prediction anyone should act on.

team_strength.per_game: points and points-against divided by games played (W+L+T)

formula: ppg_t = pf_t / games_t ; apg_t = pa_t / games_t
injury_adj_t = sum over that club's Week-10 rows of weight[position_group] * multiplier[game_status]
signal = |home_spread| relative to the two prior in-repo models (delta shown, no model adopted)

assumptions.basis: repo convention; two prior sessions used 0.0 and 2.0 and neither calibrated it
Munich game (NE at DET) treated as no home edge; not verified against any league document
availability expectation, not a league rule; the play-rate convention is cited to a secondary source (SRC-12)
analyst placeholder; must be replaced by calibration (Q-07) before any use
a prior session used 0.5; shrinkage is a hedge against 9-week noise, untested
published rounding rule of this build, not a market claim

assumptions.value: assumed starter if listed Out/Doubtful and named as a starter by an official news page; otherwise treated as unspecified
assumptions.basis: no official depth chart exists (FLG-08); BAL excluded from QB-based adjustment (FLG-06)

exclusions: No game where the starting quarterback cannot be established from an official source is given a QB-based adjustment (LAC@BAL).
No row on the site uses a market price; market columns are blank by policy (FLG-07).
Freiermuth is excluded entirely: two official NFL surfaces disagree on his designation (FLG-04).
non_goals: No staking, no bankroll, no execution, no settlement, no reward payout.
No claim of edge: gates G-00..G-10 are unpassed, so no strategy is promotable.
